name: Trickery Domain

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A divine trickster: blesses stealth, conjures an illusory double and slips between places.

feature.name: Blessing of the Trickster
feature.summary: Magic action: you or a willing creature within 30 feet has Advantage on Stealth checks until your next Long Rest.

feature.name: Invoke Duplicity
feature.summary: Channel Divinity: an illusory double for 1 minute; cast spells from its space and gain Advantage on foes next to both of you.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity use to create an illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space within 30 feet for 1 minute. You can cast spells as though you were in its space, move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action, and while you and it are both within 5 feet of a creature that can see it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

feature.name: Trickery Domain Spells
feature.summary: Always prepared: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace; more at 5, 7 and 9.

feature.name: Trickster's Transposition
feature.summary: When you create or move your duplicate, you can swap places with it.

feature.name: Improved Duplicity
feature.summary: Allies share the duplicate's Advantage; when it ends, someone near it heals your Cleric level.
